_comments.execution: Default command stages only. --run is required for execution; --smoke-test runs the first two configurations (convex_comfort and milp_comfort) with 15-minute warm-up and 30-minute evaluation in a separate directory.
_comments.warmup_hours: Controller-active hours before each case start_time; default 24, 0 disables. Excluded from all performance/solver metrics. Initial SOC settings apply at warm-up start; duration_hours counts evaluation only. This revision uses a new output directory to preserve previous frozen inputs.
_comments.cooldown_hours: Controller-active unscored post-roll, default 24 h; 0 disables. No terminal recharge or SOC reset. Horizon coverage extends beyond cooldown as well. Both regular and parametric metrics score evaluation only.
_comments.size: 2 five-day winter windows x 3 mobility seeds x 8 configurations = 48 unified jobs, each retaining 3 subsimulations. Stage only until execution is explicitly requested.
_comments.pairing: Select each seed 41/42/43 once at January's anchor. Replay identical relative trips in February, including warm-up/cooldown and forecast tail, accepting weekday mismatch. Freeze for all eight controllers; no Audi wrapping.
_comments.initial_socs: Battery SOC fractions in [0,1]. These vary between cases, never between paired baseline/twin/advanced runs.
_comments.objectives: Four convex and four MILP variants. Comfort weight 1000 throughout. SOC health weight 1000 for health/throughput/rainflow variants in each formulation, otherwise zero. Persistence, dwell/caps and discharge-budget terms are off. Terminal valuation is v*(e0-eN)/N using the daily-minimum tariff, with no separate weight. Baseline charges to comfort_soc_min=0.4.
_comments.health_weight: Overall health_weight=1 keeps monetary degradation unscaled. Physical battery/load settings are inherited unchanged from the unified home file.
_comments.solvers: SCIPY/HiGHS requires no commercial license and supports these LP/MILP masters. GUROBI may be selected after validating a local academic license; only then use solver_options {Threads: 1, Seed: 0}. Source and package fingerprints are stored. Changing the solver requires a new frozen study revision.
_comments.economics: Net savings = baseline operating + NMC reference degradation costs minus case operating + NMC reference degradation costs. Aging uses new minus residual battery value. Separate energy-adjusted net savings adds the actual starting/ending chemical-energy inventory correction at common boundary daily-minimum tariff values.
_comments.deferred: Smoothed rainflow and hh are deferred by user request; neither is included in this pilot.
_comments.scope: Audi only, HPWH/HVAC baseline, perfect EV forecasts, V2H enabled. Evaluation [Jan 3,Jan 8) and [Feb 3,Feb 8), 2018. Advanced and non-V2H summaries/variant overlays remain separate. Rainflow accuracy is checked independently of the 5% MILP objective gap.
